headline: Take-Two Generates Near $2 Billion in Revenue on Grand Theft Auto VI Launch
summary: Take-Two Interactive sold an estimated 19.1 million units of Grand Theft Auto VI by Thursday morning, generating nearly $2 billion in revenue following $1.65 billion in preorders.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a leading video game publisher, and the Grand Theft Auto series represents one of the most lucrative entertainment franchises globally.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
impacts.why: Record launch sales of 19.1 million units directly boost Take-Two's top-line revenue and cash generation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Take-Two reported unprecedented opening-day sales for Grand Theft Auto VI, driving record revenue figures.
